function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: Sure! To determine your friend's MBTI type, I’ll need the percentages for each of the personality traits. Could you share those with me? Once I have the data, I can evaluate and give you the MBTI type.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Give me the MTBI of my friend." They want the MBTI (I think they typed MTBI incorrectly). They want the MBTI of their friend. But we don't have data about their friend. We need to ask for more info or clarify. According to policy, we cannot provide MBTI without data. We can ask for traits or ask for more info. So we should respond asking for the personality trait percentages or ask for more info. The user didn't provide any data. So we should ask them to provide the percentages or traits. Also we can mention that we need data. So we should ask for the personality trait percentages.
